title: Comunicado 2026-02-05
summary: Banxico's Board unanimously held the policy rate at 7.00%, framing the move explicitly as a pause 'en esta ocasión' in the easing cycle after a run of 25bp cuts, to assess the January IEPS and tariff changes, the peso and the degree of restriction already in place. Versus the 18 December communique (a split cut, with Heath dissenting for a hold), the action turns from cutting to holding and the vote becomes unanimous, but the guidance does not close the cycle: the Board drops the emphasis on 'el momento' and says only that it will assess 'ajustes adicionales', which reads as a temporary pause with further cuts still the expected direction. The hawkish counterweight is in the data: core inflation rose to 4.47%, headline and core forecasts were revised up and convergence to 3% was pushed out to Q2 2027, though the balance of risks is called 'más equilibrado' with an upside tilt. Net, a hold with the door clearly open to resuming cuts, restrained by the worse core and forecast picture.

key_quotes.quote: La Junta de Gobierno juzgó apropiado en esta ocasión hacer una pausa en el ciclo de disminuciones de la tasa de referencia.
key_quotes.context: Explicit, one-off framing of the pause within an easing cycle that is not declared over

key_quotes.quote: Hacia delante, la Junta de Gobierno valorará realizar ajustes adicionales a la tasa de referencia.
key_quotes.context: Guidance drops December's emphasis on 'el momento', keeping further adjustments (cuts) on the table

key_quotes.quote: Ahora se espera que la inflación general converja a la meta en el segundo trimestre de 2027 (ver cuadro).
key_quotes.context: Forecasts revised up on a higher core path; convergence delayed -- the main reason for the pause

key_quotes.quote: Se considera que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico es más equilibrado, pero mantiene un sesgo al alza.
key_quotes.context: Risk balance softened to 'more balanced' though still tilted up
